name: cells
evidence: Map cell array, 13 B x N cells (unit, unit2, height, high, low, metal, feature, offsetY, offsetX, flags). Written every tick by AddUnitToMap, features, reclaim. Largest item: 13N bytes. Hash once per tick with a word-wise hash. Evidence: cell.h; line_of_sight.cpp Hashed (#136) from a copy with two groups of bytes skipped, none of which any simulation code reads: flags bit 2 (BlitFeatureGaf in info_panel.cpp set and clear it in the render pass, read only at BlitFeatureGaf), flags bit 7 (never written or tested), and bytes 10-11 (spot or footprint offsets) when the feature is not below 0xfffb or 0xfffe (every reader tests the feature first: features.cpp, AddUnitToMap (terrain.cpp)). Kept in the trace: high and low of the last column and row, which nothing writes (UpdateCellHeightRange stops at width-1 and height-1) and the game reads (BuildDerivedLayers cellp[5], ClearBorderFeatures c->low on a lava world, pass maps). Needs a #7 task: the state block must zero that memory (and #40 if a mod should fix it). Evidence: harness.cpp VisitMapCells; --poison dump diff.

name: StopOrder: new Order
schema_ref: kOrderTable, in the world row as units[i].list[k] and units[i].list2[k]
evidence: Order (0x56 B) walked from Unit.list and list2 through next. Hashed: kind, state, flags6, wakeFrame, unit and linkOwner as unit IDs, linkNext as a link ID, linkValue as an order ID, pos (x and z for the build kinds), start, the three union ints (arg0 to arg2), flags without bit 0x200000, created, subFlags, attached as an OrderFx ID. Every constructor argument member is set by the constructor (AddOrder in order_list.cpp), so the union is hashed whole and no member is skipped by order type. Skipped: the vtables, cached and flags bit 0x200000 (written and read only by DrawWeaponCoverage, markers.cpp), next (the walk carries it). Evidence: Order (order.h); DrawOrderOverlays (order_list.cpp). Skipped for build kinds: pos.y is skipped for the MobileBuild and VTOL_MobileBuild kinds (harness.cpp OrderIsBuild, matched by the kind table name). Writer of the unset value: ScoutTimer::OnTimer passes an uninitialised stack Vec3 (ai_player.cpp) to FindBuildPosition (ai_player.cpp), whose CellToWorld (SquadScoutTimer::OnTimer in ai_player.cpp) writes x and z only; GetOrderType and AddOrder copy it into Order::pos (order_list.cpp). Readers of pos.y: none in game logic. MobileBuildOrder reads x and z only (PatrolOrder in unit_orders.cpp); SnapWorldPosToFootprint (terrain.cpp) writes y for bmcode 0 and returns for mobile types; CreateUnit (units.cpp) copies pos in InitUnitFromType (InitUnitFromType) and UpdateUnitHeight (unit_position.cpp) recomputes y for a unit with motion (made for bmcode 1, units.cpp) because InitUnitFromType sets flag 0x10000 (CreateUnitFromPacket); DrawBuildFootprint only draws it. The bmcode values are closed: stock data has only bmcode 0 (276 FBIs) and 1 (356), parsed at unit_types.cpp. No MobileBuild order builds a mobile VTOL unit in stock data: the mobile builders (builder=1, bmcode=1) have no canfly=1 unit in their download/*.tdf MENUENTRY lists or guis/*.gui pages (only factories, bmcode 0, build aircraft), and the order's only unset-y writer, ScoutTimer::OnTimer's pos, is zeroed by the source (0x408100). Skipped for the Reclaim kind too: pos.y is also skipped for Reclaim and VTOL_Reclaim (harness.cpp OrderPosYUnset). Writer of the unset value: PickRandomReclaimableResourcesInRadius (terrain.cpp) walks a local Vec3 whose x and z the loops set and y never, stores it in the candidate records (PickRandomReclaimableResourcesInRadius) and copies it whole into the caller's Vec3 (PickRandomReclaimableResourcesInRadius); RepairPatrolOrder passes uninitialised energyPos and metalPos (unit_orders.cpp) and builds new Order("RECLAIM", 0, metal or energy, ...) from them (PatrolOrder), which copies the position into Order::pos (order_list.cpp). Observed: eight-pincushion-teams tick 12047, units[259].list[0] (kind Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe while pos.x and pos.z agree. Readers of pos.y: none in game logic. The ground ReclaimOrder reads order->pos through FindFeatureAtPos (explosions.cpp, x and z) and ReclaimFeature (features.cpp, x and z); AttachApproachRadiusGoal uses p[0] and p[2]; GetMapCellAtPosition reads x and z (line_of_sight.cpp). VTOL_Reclaim: the same call in VtolRepairPatrolOrder (vtol_orders.cpp) builds new Order("VTOL_RECLAIM") from its own uninitialised energyPos and metalPos. Observed: long-great-divide-2p tick 30601, units[36].list[0] (kind VTOL_Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe. Readers of pos.y: ReclaimFeature and FindFeatureAtPos read x and z (vtol_orders.cpp, CellToWorld); the PathOrder it builds (CellToWorld) is covered by the orderFx skip.

name: PackedPosGoal::DeserializeNetUnitState: new PathOrder
schema_ref: kPathOrderTable (+Heading, Piece, Follow parts), in the world row as orderFx[id]
evidence: PathOrder (0x36 B), created by the six constructors 0x44de80 to 0x44e330. Hashed: source as an order ID, flags, approachRadius, altitude, unit, the embedded link (owner, next, value), pos. heading only when flags bit 0x40 is set, piece when bit 0 is set, followOffset when (flags & 0x82) == 2: the constructors leave them unset otherwise and FillWorldPos and GetDesiredHeading read heading and piece only then. followOffset (+0x32) is skipped when bit 0x80 is set because it is then never written and never read. Writers: the VTOL branch of PathOrder(Order*, Unit*) with flags 7 (order_targets.cpp), the file loader (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading). The constructors at 0x44e250 (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading, flags 5), 0x44e2d0 (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading, flags 0x20) and 0x44e330 (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading, flags 0xa3) never write it. Readers: FillWorldPos only when (flags & 1) and not (flags & 0x80) and (flags & 2) (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading); SerializeToSave copies it into the save file (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading) without feeding logic. Writers of the flags word after construction: SetAltitude ORs 8 (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading), SetHeading sets bit 0x40 (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading), SetApproachRadius sets bit 0x10 (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading), nothing clears any bit; OrderFx::AddFlags (AirManeuverOrder::SerializeToSave) ORs into the source Order at +0x4e, not into the path order. The bit-stream constructor (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading) takes flags from the stream and leaves followOffset unset, but runs only in net games. Field list = PathOrder::SerializeToSave plus the unsaved flags. Evidence: AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading (order_targets.cpp) Skipped: pos.y (+0x2a) when the source order is a VTOL_MobileBuild or VTOL_Reclaim (harness.cpp FxPosYUnset, matched by the kind table name). Writer of the unset value: VtolMobileBuildOrder (src/orders/vtol_orders.cpp) calls CellToWorldPos, which writes x and z only (VtolPatrolOrder), then constructs PathOrder::PathOrder (order_targets.cpp) from order->pos, which holds the stack Vec3 left by ScoutTimer::OnTimer (ai_player.cpp), so pos.y is garbage until the first FillWorldPos. Flags at construction are 0x20 (field_8) and 0x10 from SetApproachRadius; SetAltitude is not called. Readers of pos.y: none in game logic. PathOrder::FillWorldPos (order_targets.cpp) overwrites pos.y (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading) before the clamp at AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading reads it; IsComplete (PathOrder::IsComplete) reads y only if flags&8 and !(flags&0x10) and returns at AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading here; save and load (AirManeuverOrder::SetHeading) only copy it. Every other PathOrder keeps pos.y hashed. VTOL_Reclaim: VtolReclaimOrder state 1 constructs the PathOrder from order->pos (vtol_orders.cpp), whose y is the unset PickRandomReclaimableResourcesInRadius stack value (terrain.cpp); the constructor flags are 0x20, with no SetAltitude, so FillWorldPos overwrites pos.y (order_targets.cpp) before the clamp.

name: InsertCommand: new Order
schema_ref: kOrderTable, in the world row as units[i].list[k] and units[i].list2[k]
evidence: Order (0x56 B) walked from Unit.list and list2 through next. Hashed: kind, state, flags6, wakeFrame, unit and linkOwner as unit IDs, linkNext as a link ID, linkValue as an order ID, pos (x and z for the build kinds), start, the three union ints (arg0 to arg2), flags without bit 0x200000, created, subFlags, attached as an OrderFx ID. Every constructor argument member is set by the constructor (AddOrder in order_list.cpp), so the union is hashed whole and no member is skipped by order type. Skipped: the vtables, cached and flags bit 0x200000 (written and read only by DrawWeaponCoverage, markers.cpp), next (the walk carries it). Evidence: Order (order.h); DrawOrderOverlays (order_list.cpp). Skipped for build kinds: pos.y is skipped for the MobileBuild and VTOL_MobileBuild kinds (harness.cpp OrderIsBuild, matched by the kind table name). Writer of the unset value: ScoutTimer::OnTimer passes an uninitialised stack Vec3 (ai_player.cpp) to FindBuildPosition (ai_player.cpp), whose CellToWorld (SquadScoutTimer::OnTimer in ai_player.cpp) writes x and z only; GetOrderType and AddOrder copy it into Order::pos (order_list.cpp). Readers of pos.y: none in game logic. MobileBuildOrder reads x and z only (PatrolOrder in unit_orders.cpp); SnapWorldPosToFootprint (terrain.cpp) writes y for bmcode 0 and returns for mobile types; CreateUnit (units.cpp) copies pos in InitUnitFromType (InitUnitFromType) and UpdateUnitHeight (unit_position.cpp) recomputes y for a unit with motion (made for bmcode 1, units.cpp) because InitUnitFromType sets flag 0x10000 (CreateUnitFromPacket); DrawBuildFootprint only draws it. The bmcode values are closed: stock data has only bmcode 0 (276 FBIs) and 1 (356), parsed at unit_types.cpp. No MobileBuild order builds a mobile VTOL unit in stock data: the mobile builders (builder=1, bmcode=1) have no canfly=1 unit in their download/*.tdf MENUENTRY lists or guis/*.gui pages (only factories, bmcode 0, build aircraft), and the order's only unset-y writer, ScoutTimer::OnTimer's pos, is zeroed by the source (0x408100). Skipped for the Reclaim kind too: pos.y is also skipped for Reclaim and VTOL_Reclaim (harness.cpp OrderPosYUnset). Writer of the unset value: PickRandomReclaimableResourcesInRadius (terrain.cpp) walks a local Vec3 whose x and z the loops set and y never, stores it in the candidate records (PickRandomReclaimableResourcesInRadius) and copies it whole into the caller's Vec3 (PickRandomReclaimableResourcesInRadius); RepairPatrolOrder passes uninitialised energyPos and metalPos (unit_orders.cpp) and builds new Order("RECLAIM", 0, metal or energy, ...) from them (PatrolOrder), which copies the position into Order::pos (order_list.cpp). Observed: eight-pincushion-teams tick 12047, units[259].list[0] (kind Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe while pos.x and pos.z agree. Readers of pos.y: none in game logic. VTOL_Reclaim: the same call in VtolRepairPatrolOrder (vtol_orders.cpp) builds new Order("VTOL_RECLAIM") from its own uninitialised energyPos and metalPos. Observed: long-great-divide-2p tick 30601, units[36].list[0] (kind VTOL_Reclaim, created that tick), pos.y differs between two runs of one exe. Readers of pos.y: ReclaimFeature and FindFeatureAtPos read x and z (vtol_orders.cpp, CellToWorld); the PathOrder it builds (CellToWorld) is covered by the orderFx skip.
